title: Mining machinery and mineral processing equipment
text: Design and manufacture of equipment for conveying, crushing, sizing and separating minerals, focused on hard and heavy materials such as ferrochrome, ferromanganese, ferroalloy products and industrial slag.

items.title: Crushing equipment
items.text: Crushing equipment: double-toggle jaw crushers and crushing equipment for hard and heavy materials.

items.title: Sizing equipment
items.text: Sizing equipment: industrial screens and equipment for separating materials by size.

items.title: Gravity separation equipment
items.text: Gravity separation equipment: jig machines and shaking tables.

items.title: Material transfer equipment
items.text: Material transfer equipment: feeding and conveying equipment between processing stages.

items.title: Complete crushing and processing line equipment
items.text: Complete crushing and processing line equipment.

title: Industrial machinery, equipment and parts
text: Manufacture of machinery, equipment and parts for factory production lines, not limited to one industry, including steel, cement and ferroalloy plants.

items.title: Molten metal handling
items.text: Molten metal handling: ladles for carrying molten metal and related equipment.

items.title: Material handling
items.text: Material handling: industrial hooks, material transfer equipment for smelting lines and handling of finished products.

items.title: Industrial dust collection
items.text: Industrial dust collection: dust-collection cyclones and related parts.

items.title: Production line parts and equipment
items.text: Production line parts and equipment: custom parts, mechanical assemblies and special equipment.

title: Engineering, design and machinery rebuilding services
text: Turning customer needs into engineering designs, building special-purpose machines, reverse engineering and rebuilding existing equipment.

items.title: Special-purpose machines
items.text: Special-purpose machines: requirements intake, 3D modeling, drawings, manufacturing, assembly and testing.

items.title: Reverse engineering and improvement
items.text: Reverse engineering and improvement: examining an existing sample, performance analysis, defect identification, design correction and manufacturing.

items.title: Heavy and mining machinery rebuilding
items.text: Heavy and mining machinery rebuilding: loader and excavator structures, hydraulic jacks, bucket rebuilding and reinforcement.

items.title: Industrial parts
items.text: Industrial parts: overhaul of mechanical assemblies, replacement parts and equipment improvement.

title: Export agricultural machinery
text: Land-leveling machinery with laser and satellite control systems, offered for export.
